title: Record the initial amplitude of register 359
body:
## Summary
- The literal execution assigns register 359 the scalar `256` and expands it by scaling the constant vector.
- The first amplitude of that expansion is real `256`, imaginary `0`, at exponent `0`.
- The saved receipt stores the scalar and not the amplitude. No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The 26,099 events are not replayed.
